entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's a piece of absolute garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand Pulse. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or perhaps a preference?
It's a technical fault! It's broken! The heart rate is all over the place, and it won't sync with the app half the time. Look, I don't have time to play tech support with you. I just want money back.
I certainly understand wanting a product that works correctly. For defect claims, my first step is to connect you with our technical support team. They can verify the issue and...
No! I am not being transferred. I don't want to troubleshoot this thing. I want a refund. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to a manager and light you guys up on Twitter?

There's no need for that, sir. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Let me just pull up your order information and review the policy. Can I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's mike.henderson@email.com. Just process the return.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order. You received the VeloBand Pulse about 35 days ago, on December 17th.
Yeah, and it's been a headache ever since. So, are you going to give me my money back?
Let me just check the policy here... Okay, yes. I can help with that. According to our policy, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Wait, really? So you're approving the refund?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's been less than 10 days, I can go ahead and authorize a full return for you. I've just initiated that in our system. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label to send the band back to us.
Oh. Okay, well... that's better. That's what you should have done from the start.
I apologize for the confusion. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Just make sure that email comes through.
It will be there within the hour. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
